name: Statamic
description_en:
Statamic is a self-hosted content management system built on Laravel. Developers model content using Blueprints and fields; editors work with entries, assets, navigation and live preview. It supports a flat-file approach and also advertises database-backed operation. Hosting and application maintenance remain part of the implementation.

Free Core serves a single administrator with one form. Pro adds team, revision, multilingual and headless capabilities at a per-site price. Available source code should not be confused with unrestricted reuse: the actual6.x license read imposes production, license-validation and code-reuse conditions, despite documentation calling Core open source.
description_zh:
Statamic 是基于 Laravel 的自托管内容管理系统。开发者使用 Blueprints 和字段设计内容，编辑者管理条目、资产、导航及实时预览；它支持文件优先方式，也宣传数据库存储模式。主机和应用维护仍属实施工作。

免费 Core 面向一名管理员、一个表单；Pro 按站点收费，增加团队、修订、多语言及无头能力。源码可读不等于无限制复用：实读6.x许可对生产环境、许可验证及代码复用设条件，尽管文档将 Core 称为开源。

sections.title_en: Design the editing model before handing it to a team
sections.title_zh: 交给团队前设计编辑模型
sections.en:
For a studio portfolio, define a project collection with title, summary, image assets and reusable content blocks. A developer builds the template and Blueprint; an editor creates a project and checks its Live Preview. Navigation, taxonomies and Globals provide separate ways to organize and reuse information. This is an illustrative workflow, not an imported project or a tested editor session.

Flat-file storage can place content/configuration under version control, but the homepage also presents database mode. Choose the actual repository/storage approach before designing deployment and backup. A Git repository is not automatically a complete media, secret or database backup, and a restored content file is not proof that the complete site has recovered.
sections.zh:
例如工作室作品集可建项目集合，包含标题、摘要、图片资产及复用内容区块。开发者建立模板和 Blueprint，编辑者创建项目并检查 Live Preview；导航、分类体系及 Globals 分别支持组织和复用。上述为流程示例，未导入项目或实测编辑器。

文件存储可让内容/配置进入版本管理，但首页也展示数据库模式。应先确定实际存储方式，再设计部署和备份。Git 仓库不会自动成为完整媒体、密钥或数据库备份，恢复内容文件也不能证明整站已恢复。

sections.title_en: Avoid sharing the free administrator account
sections.title_zh: 避免共用免费管理员账户
sections.en:
Core includes one super-admin account, one form, content modeling, assets, Live Preview and frontend capabilities. The pricing FAQ permits personal or managed client projects, but specifically discourages sharing that single account. A team needing distinct permissions should evaluate Pro rather than build its process around a shared login.

Pro includes unlimited users/roles, drafts and revisions, multi-site/multilingual editing, REST/GraphQL, white labeling and control-panel Git automation. Free Pro use during development is trial mode, not permission to launch Pro publicly without a license. Installation and paid add-on choices can change the required licenses.

Edition and validation details: [official licensing documentation](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/licensing).
sections.zh:
Core含一名超级管理员、一个表单、内容建模、资产、Live Preview及前端能力。定价FAQ允许个人或由本人管理的客户项目，但特别不建议共用该账户；需要分人权限的团队应评估Pro，不能围绕共享登录设计流程。

Pro含不限用户/角色、草稿和修订、多站/语言编辑、REST/GraphQL、白标及控制台Git自动化。开发期免费使用Pro是试用模式，并不授权无需许可公开上线；安装及付费扩展选择也会影响所需许可。

版本及验证细节：[官方许可文档](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/licensing)。

sections.title_en: Budget per production site and update period
sections.title_zh: 按生产站点和更新期预算
sections.en:
Pro displaysUSD349 per site including one year of updates, thenUSD99 per year for further updates. Basic Developer Support is described as email guidance on a2–3business-day expectation; it is not the guaranteed-response premium SLA. Enterprise adds tailored support/procurement and offline/private validation arrangements without a public numeric quote. Hosting, custom work, add-ons and starter-kit terms remain separate.

The pricing page offers a14-day purchase refund and an owner-approved license-transfer process. The commercial agreement read is dated August2020, prohibits software transfer without permission and makes no guaranteed support response; confirm how the account transfer process, current license and proposal govern the purchase. This record does not assume automatic unlimited upgrades or a particular behavior after update eligibility expires.
sections.zh:
Pro显示每站USD349，含一年更新，后续更新每年USD99。Basic Developer Support描述邮件指导，预期2–3个工作日，不能视为保证响应的付费高级SLA。Enterprise提供定制支持/采购及离线/私有验证安排，未公开数字报价；主机、定制、扩展及启动模板条款另计。

定价页提供购买后14天退款及经所有者接受的许可转移流程。实读商业协议日期为2020年8月，未经许可禁止转让软件且不保证支持响应；需确认账户转移流程、当前许可和提案如何适用。本档案不假定自动无限升级或更新资格到期后的具体行为。

sections.title_en: Read the license rather than infer rights from GitHub
sections.title_zh: 读取许可，不从 GitHub 推断权利
sections.en:
The6.x documentation calls Core free/open source, but the actual6.x code license restricts a licensed copy to one production environment, prohibits altering validation/edition/update controls and requires consent for code reuse in other projects. It also requires retained notices and provides no warranty. Those restrictions do not support a permissive-open-source classification for the reviewed code. The record therefore treats the source as restricted; any claimed distinct Core license should be supplied and reconciled before redistribution.

The older website commercial agreement is also restrictive, while the current code notice has different wording. Record the exact release and applicable agreement instead of treating the opening permission language as MIT. These are product-license observations, not legal advice.

Primary texts: [6.x code license](https://github.com/statamic/cms/blob/6.x/LICENSE.md), [edition documentation](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/licensing).
sections.zh:
6.x文档将Core称为免费/开源，但实读6.x源码许可限定一个许可副本只用于一个生产环境，禁止修改验证/版本/更新控制，其他项目复用代码需同意，并要求保留声明、不提供保证。这些限制不支持对实读代码作宽松开源分类，因此本记录将源码视为受限；如声称Core另有许可，再分发前应取得并消解冲突。

较旧官网商业协议同样有限制，但当前源码声明措辞不同。应记录确切版本及适用协议，不能因开头的授权语言类似就当作MIT。这是产品许可观察，不是法律意见。

原始文本：[6.x源码许可](https://github.com/statamic/cms/blob/6.x/LICENSE.md)、[版本文档](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/licensing)。

sections.title_en: Plan PHP operations and license connectivity
sections.title_zh: 规划 PHP 运营及许可连接
sections.en:
The official6.x requirements list PHP8.3+, Composer, listed PHP extensions and GD or ImageMagick for image processing. Installation choices include Laravel Herd, CLI, an existing Laravel app, Docker/Sail and cloud hosts. This is a self-hosted Laravel package; no installer or hosting option was executed here. Match extensions, Laravel and Statamic versions before an upgrade.

Licensing documentation says a logged-in control panel periodically sends the key, public-domain information and PHP version to the vendor validation service, normally hourly; changing a key triggers an immediate check. Offline operation needs an agreed arrangement. Budget network/data requirements rather than disabling validation. The same guide says free Core without commercial add-ons does not require linking an account Site.

Sources: [6.x requirements](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/requirements), [installation choices](https://statamic.dev/installing), [validation behavior](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/licensing).
sections.zh:
官方6.x要求列PHP8.3+、Composer、指定PHP扩展，以及用于图像处理的GD或ImageMagick。安装方式有Laravel Herd、CLI、现有Laravel应用、Docker/Sail及云主机；这是自托管Laravel包，本次未执行任何安装或主机选项，升级前需匹配扩展、Laravel及Statamic版本。

许可文档称登录中的控制台会定期向厂商验证服务发送许可密钥、公开域名信息及PHP版本，通常每小时一次，改密钥立即验证；离线运行需约定安排。应规划网络/数据要求，不应关闭验证。同页也称免费Core且无商业扩展时无需关联账户Site。

来源：[6.x要求](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/requirements)、[安装方式](https://statamic.dev/installing)、[验证行为](https://statamic.dev/getting-started/licensing)。

sections.title_en: Test the storage and team configuration actually being purchased
sections.title_zh: 测试实际采购的存储及团队配置
sections.en:
Statamic is a plausible fit for a Laravel-capable team wanting a tailored editorial interface and ownership of hosting/content. A single maintainer can evaluate Core; independent client/editor accounts, multilingual sites or a headless frontend move the evaluation to Pro. A team seeking a fully operated website should separately obtain hosting and maintenance.

Pilot a real collection, media upload, a second role if licensed, revision recovery and deployment. For APIs or static generation, check authentication, rebuilds, dynamic form behavior and cache/media dependencies in the selected architecture. The feature list alone does not prove full dynamic behavior survives static output. No account, multi-user edit, API, migration, update-expiry behavior or restore was tested.
sections.zh:
有Laravel能力、希望定制编辑界面并自行掌握主机/内容的团队可评估Statamic。单人维护者可试Core；独立客户/编辑账户、多语言站或无头前端则需评估Pro。需要全运营网站的团队应另行取得托管及维护服务。

试点应涵盖实际集合、媒体上传、许可允许时的第二角色、修订恢复及部署。API或静态生成需检查认证、重建、动态表单行为和缓存/媒体依赖，不能单凭功能清单认定静态输出保留完整动态行为。本次未测试账户、多用户编辑、API、迁移、更新到期行为或恢复。
